name: Cyclic sighing

cues.text: Breathe in through your nose, take a short second sip of air, then breathe out slowly through your mouth.
There are no holds. Keep the top-up small and easy.
If you feel dizzy, stop and breathe normally.

stop_prompts: Stop if you feel dizzy or lightheaded.
Stop if you feel tingling or numbness in your hands or face.
Stop if your chest feels tight.
Stop if your vision changes or blurs.
You can stop at any time.

copy.intent: Two easy in-breaths through the nose, then a long, slow out-breath.
copy.end: Let your breath return to its own rhythm. Notice how you feel now.
copy.notice: This is not medical advice. If you have a health condition or feel unwell, speak to a qualified clinician before you practise.

note: Exact seconds are not in the read text of Balban 2023; the research says use a team choice. The 3 s in, 1 s top-up, 6 s out split is a team choice set to the research default rate of 6 breaths per minute. Evidence: one remote RCT with small arms. Verify before release against the full paper.
